```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggplot2")
if (!requireNamespace("dplyr",   quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!requireNamespace("knitr",   quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("knitr")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

# Import des données

```{r data-import, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
results      <- read.csv2("../expe/results_filtered.csv", sep = ",")
participants <- read.csv2("../expe/participants_filtered.csv", sep = ",")

# Filtrage immédiat
results <- results[results$correcte == TRUE, ]
results <- results[results$participant %in% participants$id, ]

# Recodage des conditions
results$feedback <- factor(
  ifelse(results$conditionId %in% c("C1", "C3"), "Présent", "Absent"),
  levels = c("Présent", "Absent")
)
results$densite <- factor(
  ifelse(results$conditionId %in% c("C1", "C2"), "Basse (10 liens)", "Haute (30  liens)"),
  levels = c("Basse (10 liens)", "Haute (30  liens)")
)

results$temps_completion <- as.numeric(results$temps_completion)

cat("Essais chargés :", nrow(results), "\n")
cat("Participants :", nrow(participants), "\n")
```

---

# Population

```{r stat-desc, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Sexe des participants
cat("## Répartition par genre\n\n")
kable(table(participants$genre), col.names = c("Genre", "N"))

# Age des participants
cat("\n## Âge des participants\n\n")
cat("**Médiane :**", median(participants$age, na.rm = TRUE), "ans\n\n")
cat("**Écart-type :**", round(sd(participants$age, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n\n")
```

```{r boxplot-age, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
ggplot(participants, aes(y = age)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#7B9CDA", color = "#2C4A8C", width = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Distribution de l'âge des participants", y = "Âge") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

cat("--- Âge Min ---\n")
min(participants$age)
cat("\n--- Âge Max ---\n")
max(participants$age)
```

# VD1 : Temps de complétion

> Temps en secondes entre l'affichage de la page et le clic sur la cible.

```{r vd1-prep, echo=FALSE}
results <- results %>%
  arrange(participant, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  ungroup()

# Retirer valeurs aberrantes (< 0 ou > 5 minutes)
results_temps <- results %>%
  filter(!is.na(temps_completion), temps_completion > 0, temps_completion < 300)
```

```{r vd1-stats, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
stats_temps <- results_temps %>%
  group_by(feedback, densite) %>%
  summarise(
    N       = n(),
    Médiane = round(median(temps_completion, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD      = round(sd(temps_completion,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min     = round(min(temps_completion,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max     = round(max(temps_completion,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(stats_temps, caption = "Temps de complétion (secondes) par condition")
```

```{r vd1-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(results_temps, aes(x = densite, y = temps_completion, fill = feedback)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Présent" = "#7B9CDA", "Absent" = "#DA7B7B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Temps de complétion selon le feedback et la densité",
    x     = "Densité d'information",
    y     = "Temps de complétion (secondes)",
    fill  = "Feedback visuel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r vd1-test, echo=FALSE}
temps_agg <- results_temps %>%
  group_by(participant, feedback, densite) %>%
  summarise(temps_moyen = mean(temps_completion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

modele_temps <- aov(temps_moyen ~ feedback * densite + Error(participant / densite),
                    data = temps_agg)
summary(modele_temps)

coefficients(modele_temps)
```

# VD2 : Taux de clics redondants

> Nombre de clics effectués sur des liens déjà consultés au cours d'une même tâche (`revisits_cumulative`).

```{r vd2-stats, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
stats_revisits <- results %>%
  group_by(feedback, densite) %>%
  summarise(
    N       = n(),
    Médiane = round(median(revisits_cumulative, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD      = round(sd(revisits_cumulative,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min     = min(revisits_cumulative,           na.rm = TRUE),
    Max     = max(revisits_cumulative,           na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(stats_revisits, caption = "Clics redondants par condition")
```

```{r vd2-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(results, aes(x = densite, y = revisits_cumulative, fill = feedback)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Présent" = "#7B9CDA", "Absent" = "#DA7B7B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Clics redondants selon le feedback et la densité",
    x     = "Densité d'information",
    y     = "Nombre de clics redondants",
    fill  = "Feedback visuel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r vd2-test, echo=FALSE}
revisits_agg <- results %>%
  group_by(participant, feedback, densite) %>%
  summarise(revisits_moyen = mean(revisits_cumulative, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

modele_revisits <- aov(revisits_moyen ~ feedback * densite + Error(participant / densite),
                       data = revisits_agg)
summary(modele_revisits)
```

# Results

```{r variabilite-temps-facet, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
ggplot(results_temps, aes(x = textId, y = temps_completion, fill = feedback)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Présent" = "#7B9CDA", "Absent" = "#DA7B7B")) +
  facet_wrap(~ densite) +
  labs(
    title = "Variabilité du temps de complétion par texte, feedback et densité",
    x     = "Texte",
    y     = "Temps de complétion (secondes)",
    fill  = "Feedback visuel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
